verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own stale-flag capability: the pricing page lists 'Track stale feature flags with a dedicated dashboard'. That covers the stale-flag discovery half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows code-reference scanning or any tooling that helps remove flags from the codebase, and the generic GitHub integration mention does not establish code references. missing for 10: code-reference discovery in repositories, cleanup/removal workflow for temporary flags, in-depth docs on stale-flag detection criteria, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find stale flags and code references so temporary flags actually get removed from the codebase

citations.quote: Track stale feature flags with a dedicated dashboard
